title.ja: Infrastructure Composer: template を図で読む、図から書く
title.en: Infrastructure Composer: Reading a Template as a Diagram, and Drawing One

sources.title: What is AWS Infrastructure Composer? - AWS Infrastructure Composer Developer Guide
supports: End of support notice at the top: the standalone console is unavailable from December 7, 2026; the embedded console experiences were replaced by a visual IaC editor; the full experience remains in the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
Infrastructure Composer can be used from its console, the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code, and in CloudFormation console mode
It creates CloudFormation and AWS SAM templates and syncs changes between the canvas and the template code
Existing CloudFormation and AWS SAM templates can be imported to visualize and modify them
Any CloudFormation resource can be dragged onto the canvas

sources.title: AWS Infrastructure Composer end of support
supports: End of support is effective December 7, 2026; no new customers from October 29, 2026 (stated as a target date in the FAQ)
The standalone URL console.aws.amazon.com/composer is not accessible after December 7, 2026
The AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code keeps the visual authoring experience; no changes are planned
The embedded experience in the CloudFormation console is replaced by a visual editor integrated in that console
The Export to Infrastructure Composer entries in the Lambda and Step Functions consoles are removed
Infrastructure Composer exposes no customer-facing API, SDK or CLI
Templates saved locally or in Amazon S3, and existing stacks, are not affected
How to open a template in VS Code: the button in the editor, the context menu, or the Command Palette

sources.title: AWS Infrastructure Composer
supports: Notice: no longer available to new customers as of October 29, 2026; existing customers until December 7, 2026

sources.title: Document history for Infrastructure Composer
supports: The end of support notice was added on September 29, 2026
Public release December 1, 2022; general availability March 7, 2023; all CloudFormation resources September 26, 2023; VS Code November 30, 2023; CloudFormation console mode March 28, 2024

sources.title: AWS Application Composer is now AWS Infrastructure Composer
supports: AWS Application Composer was renamed AWS Infrastructure Composer; posted October 4, 2024

sources.title: Using Infrastructure Composer in CloudFormation console mode
supports: CloudFormation console mode has no local sync
Lambda Function and Lambda Layer cards need builds and packaging that are not available in that mode
sources.note: The page still describes the mode as the recommended tool to visualize templates; the end of support page says the embedded experience is being replaced.

sources.title: Configure and modify cards in Infrastructure Composer
supports: An enhanced component card is a collection of CloudFormation resources combined into one curated card
A standard IaC resource card represents a single CloudFormation resource

sources.title: Standard cards in Infrastructure Composer
supports: All CloudFormation resources are available as standard IaC resource cards
A standard card starts from a template with the type, required or common properties, and placeholders for their value types

sources.title: Card connections in Infrastructure Composer
supports: A line between cards represents an event-driven relationship
Lines between enhanced component cards are solid; connections of standard cards are detected from the template and drawn dotted
Standard cards have no connector ports
Connecting enhanced cards provisions, when necessary, IAM policies (through AWS SAM policy templates), environment variables, and events

sources.title: Group cards together on Infrastructure Composer's visual canvas
supports: Enhanced cards are grouped by hand; a standard card is grouped into another when the template references it, as a role referenced by a function
sources.note: The page does not say what grouping writes into the template.

sources.title: Locally sync and save your project in the Infrastructure Composer console
supports: By default the template is saved by hand; local sync saves it automatically to the local machine
Local sync writes the template, project folders, a backup directory named .aws-composer, and supported external files
Local sync is off by default

sources.title: Allow web page access to local files in Infrastructure Composer
supports: Local sync needs a browser with the File System Access API; recent Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge are named
Infrastructure Composer gets read and write access to the allowed project folder and its children; the data is not stored beyond the local file system

sources.title: Reference external files in Infrastructure Composer
supports: External files are supported for API Gateway REST APIs (OpenAPI) and Step Functions state machine definitions

sources.title: View code updates with the Change Inspector in Infrastructure Composer
supports: The Change Inspector shows the template code added and removed by the most recent interaction on the canvas

sources.title: Using Infrastructure Composer from the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
supports: Deployment from VS Code goes through sam sync of the AWS SAM CLI

sources.title: Visual overview of Infrastructure Composer from the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
supports: The parts of the canvas in VS Code: resource palette, list, arrange, sync, resource properties panel, card, line, group, port
Delete removes the card from the canvas and from the template

sources.title: Access Infrastructure Composer from the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
supports: The Toolkit for VS Code must be installed first; the canvas opens from a CloudFormation or AWS SAM template
sources.note: Neither this page nor the Toolkit guide says whether JSON templates open, or whether AWS credentials are needed to draw.

sources.title: Working with AWS Infrastructure Composer in the Toolkit - AWS Toolkit for VS Code
supports: Changes made on the canvas are stored persistently, so one can switch between the file in the editor and the canvas
Three ways to open: the button in the editor, the context menu, the Command Palette
sources.note: The context menu entry is written here as Open with App Composer, and on the end of support page as Open with Infrastructure Composer.

sources.title: AWS Infrastructure Composer FAQs
supports: There is no additional charge for using Infrastructure Composer; resources created with it are billed as usual
CloudFormation and AWS SAM templates can be imported and visualized
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetcher. The page names neither YAML nor JSON, and does not mention the AWS CDK.

sources.title: Edit templates visually with template studio - AWS CloudFormation User Guide
supports: Template studio shows the template as text beside a diagram of its resources; the text is authoritative and the diagram cannot be edited
The diagram draws a connection wherever one resource refers to another through Ref, Fn::GetAtt, Fn::Sub, or DependsOn; a resource nothing references appears on its own
A role assumed by three functions is shown inside each function although the template declares one
It opens from the navigation pane, from Create stack, from an existing stack's update, and wherever the console shows a template
Edits are not saved automatically; saving writes to Amazon S3 at standard S3 rates, by default to the bucket CloudFormation manages for uploaded templates
It converts between YAML and JSON; YAML to JSON discards comments
Validate uses ValidateTemplate with TemplateBody, limited to 51,200 bytes
The diagram downloads as a PNG
Permissions: cloudformation:GetTemplate, s3:GetObject, cloudformation:ValidateTemplate, s3:PutObject, s3:CreateBucket, s3:ListBucket
sources.note: The older address infrastructure-composer-for-cloudformation.html in the same guide now serves this page. The page does not use the name Infrastructure Composer and does not say how a file on the local machine is opened.

sources.title: Ref - CloudFormation Template Reference Guide
supports: Ref takes the logical name of a resource or a parameter
With the AWS::LanguageExtensions transform the argument can be another intrinsic function

sources.title: Fn::GetAtt - CloudFormation Template Reference Guide
supports: JSON syntax is a pair [logicalNameOfResource, attributeName]; the dotted single string is the YAML short form
Without AWS::LanguageExtensions the logical name must be a string and the attribute name may only use Ref

sources.title: Fn::Sub - CloudFormation Template Reference Guide
supports: Fn::Sub takes a string, or a string and a map of variables
${Name} resolves like Ref and ${Name.Attribute} like Fn::GetAtt
${!Literal} is written out as ${Literal}

sources.title: DependsOn attribute - CloudFormation Template Reference Guide
supports: DependsOn takes a string or a list of strings; the resource is created after the ones it names
Ref, GetAtt and Sub create implicit dependencies: the referenced resource is created first and deleted last

sources.title: Troubleshooting CloudFormation
supports: Read to look for a statement on circular dependencies; the page has none
sources.note: How CloudFormation answers a template whose references form a cycle was not confirmed from a page read for this chapter.

definition.ja: CloudFormation と SAM のテンプレートを、カードと線の図として表示し、図からも編集できる AWS の道具。以前の名前は Application Composer。単独のコンソールは 2026 年 12 月 7 日に終わり、AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code の中のものが残る。
definition.en: An AWS tool that shows a CloudFormation or SAM template as a diagram of cards and lines and lets you edit it from the diagram. Formerly Application Composer. Its standalone console ends on December 7, 2026; the one inside the AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code remains.

definition.ja: CloudFormation のコンソールにあるテンプレートのエディタ。テンプレートの文字の横に、リソースと参照の図を表示する。正本は文字で、図からは編集できない。
definition.en: The template editor in the CloudFormation console. It shows a diagram of resources and references beside the template text. The text is authoritative; the diagram cannot be edited.

note.ja: 5 ファイル 46 件。たどる 4 つの形とたどらない形、Fn::Sub の属性・リテラル・対応表、パラメーターと擬似パラメーター、テンプレートに無い名前、省いた種類、Type の無い項目と Fn::ForEach の拒否、要約（数、参照されないリソース、鎖、輪）、2 つのテンプレートの比較、文字と図の出力、本文の図と CLI の出力の一致、cdk.out からの選択
note.en: 5 files, 46 tests. The four forms followed and the forms not followed; attributes, literals and map variables of Fn::Sub; parameters and pseudo parameters; names missing from the template; omitted types; refusing an entry without a Type and Fn::ForEach; the summary (counts, unreferenced resources, chains, cycles); the comparison of two templates; text and figure output; that the figure in the pages equals the CLI's output; choosing a template in cdk.out

note.ja: fixture のグラフを表示。本文に載せた出力はこの実行のもの。--figure の出力を本文の図に貼った
note.en: Printed the fixture's graph; the output quoted in the chapter is from this run. The --figure output was pasted into the chapter's figure

note.ja: hello:infra:synth のあと AihHello を表示。2 リソース、1 つながり
note.en: After hello:infra:synth, printed AihHello: 2 resources, 1 connection

note.ja: ship:cfn:synth のあと AihShipApi を表示。18 リソース、29 つながり、いちばん長い鎖は 7
note.en: After ship:cfn:synth, printed AihShipApi: 18 resources, 29 connections, longest chain 7

records.command: node scripts/graph.ts <リポジトリにあった cdk.out のテンプレート 50 個>

note.ja: 50 個すべてを読めた。テンプレートに無い名前と輪は 0。ほかの章が書きかけの時点の数
note.en: All 50 templates found in the repository's cdk.out directories were read; no missing names and no cycles. The count is from a moment when other chapters were still being written

note.ja: コンソールを開いていない

summary.ja: VS Code の Infrastructure Composer を開いていない。cdk.out の JSON のテンプレートを開けるか、どのリソースが enhanced component card になるか、開いて保存しただけでテンプレートがどう変わるか、図の表示に認証情報が要るかは確かめていない。
summary.en: Infrastructure Composer in VS Code was not opened. Whether it opens the JSON templates in cdk.out, which resources become enhanced component cards, how a template changes when merely opened and saved, and whether drawing needs credentials are unconfirmed.

resume.ja: VS Code に AWS Toolkit を入れ、vp run hello:infra:synth のあと examples/02-toolchain/cdk.out/AihHello.template.json を開いて Infrastructure Composer のボタンを押す。線を vp run composer:graph:hello の出力と比べる。ファイルを複製して図から何も変えずに保存し、vp run composer:graph ../02-toolchain AihHello --against <複製> と diff で元と比べる。
resume.en: Install the AWS Toolkit in VS Code, run vp run hello:infra:synth, open examples/02-toolchain/cdk.out/AihHello.template.json and press the Infrastructure Composer button. Compare the lines with the output of vp run composer:graph:hello. Copy the file, save it from the diagram unchanged, and compare with the original using vp run composer:graph ../02-toolchain AihHello --against <copy> and diff.

summary.ja: template studio を開いていない。このモジュールのグラフが template studio の図と同じ線になるか、手元のファイルを読み込む手順があるかは確かめていない。template studio が告知の言う置き換えのエディタだというのは、以前の Infrastructure Composer のページの URL が template studio のページを返すことからの判断。
summary.en: Template studio was not opened. Whether this module's graph has the same lines as its diagram, and whether a local file can be loaded, are unconfirmed. That template studio is the replacement editor of the notice is a judgment from the former Infrastructure Composer page's URL now returning the template studio page.

resume.ja: CloudFormation のコンソールでナビゲーションの Template studio を開き、examples/20-shipping/cdk.out/AihShipApi.template.json の中身をエディタに貼り付ける。図の線を vp run composer:graph:ship の connections と 1 本ずつ比べ、違いがあれば src/graph.ts のたどり方を直す。保存はしない。
resume.en: In the CloudFormation console open Template studio from the navigation and paste the contents of examples/20-shipping/cdk.out/AihShipApi.template.json into the editor. Compare the diagram's lines one by one with the connections printed by vp run composer:graph:ship, and fix the walk in src/graph.ts where they differ. Do not save.

summary.ja: 参照が輪になったテンプレートを CloudFormation がどう扱うかは、読んだページから確認できなかった。
summary.en: How CloudFormation treats a template whose references form a cycle could not be confirmed from the pages read.

resume.ja: CloudFormation のユーザーガイドで circular dependency の記述を探す。見つからなければ、輪のある 2 リソースのテンプレートを aws cloudformation validate-template にかけて応答を記録する（読み取りだが認証情報が要る）。
resume.en: Look for a statement on circular dependencies in the CloudFormation User Guide. Failing that, run aws cloudformation validate-template on a two-resource template with a cycle and record the answer (a read, but it needs credentials).
